# Policy-KB bijection audit — microsoft_365_subscriptions / task 0

## revision_1

Scope: licensing_ext_reduction_credit, licensing_ext_late_charge, licensing_ext_payment_arrangement (whole domain, every tier); their base policies licensing_cancellation_window, licensing_billing_and_collections, licensing_client_authorization; the variant parameters they read (E3 and every other plan's rows of the same columns); task tools post_reduction_credit_23f8ed2c, assess_late_charge_e02563fc, pay_arrangement_instalment_a0d5f2e9. Source: licensing.extended.yaml sha256=0ab2f241…a2a4; corpus: docs/licensing (57 files) tree sha256=48d9fe95…db2e. Doc meta was not used as evidence.

## source_to_kb

**Variant parameters.** All six plans' annual_price, surcharge, premium, terms, card limit, net terms, late-fee %, grace, minimum, suspension threshold, cancellation/added-seat windows, refund_on_window_reduction, admin_fee, waiver and baseline switches were compared cell by cell with csp_price_list_and_billing_terms, payment_terms_and_collections_schedule, commitment_windows_and_renewal_schedule and administration_fee_and_managed_baseline_schedule: all equal.

**licensing_ext_reduction_credit** (state_due, target post_reduction_credit_23f8ed2c)
- Overwrite of licensing_cancellation_window refund clause: retired surface in cancellation_and_reduction_windows term 6 ("This clause is no longer in force as written: …" quoted verbatim) with both replaced_by branches (whole-term reduction → reduction credit schedule; cancellation → cancellation schedule; other subscriptions keep the old formula; credited to the invoice that billed the cycle). Repeated in in_window_reduction_credit "Scope". Other clauses of the base policy (terms 1–5, 7) stand as in force. Equivalent.
- Baseline (computation doc reduction_credit_amount): latest in-window reduction (a), cycle = current term inclusive (b), cycle amount P1M/P1Y-annual (c), prorated less 25.00 fee (d), rounding once (e). Default constant 25.00 rendered; no assembly step elsewhere. Equivalent.
- Order clause (method → percentages on that prorated amount → fixed amounts; one rounding): carried by entailment — Basis A/B redefine "the prorated amount"; review goodwill is "percent of the prorated amount"; goodwill and fee are added/netted amounts; (e) rounds once. Equivalent.
- early_release_anchor (crediting basis doc): renewal-window definition, opening lag, Basis A (all three conditions, ≤ 2 days, no day count), Basis B (proportional reversal of the source seat addition's partial-cycle charge), "Neither basis" incl. no-charge and no-record cases. Full ladder.
- clearpath_change_fee (license_change_fee_by_clearpath_coverage): 0.00 for active/notice_given + M365 administration; 10.00 for active Monitor; otherwise "not reduced under this schedule" (= standard). Names ClearPath Managed IT Services and the record fields read. Full ladder.
- posting_delay_goodwill (billing_delay_goodwill): >30 → 50.00, 8–30 → 25.00, ≤7 → none, with boundary table 7/8/30/31. Full ladder.
- review_miss_goodwill (pre_renewal_review_goodwill): renewal-window definition, ≥4 → 5%, 1–3 → 2.5%, otherwise none (three exclusions). Full ladder; names vCIO reviews per contract year (managed matrix wording).
- Tool contract: params, owner (agent), effect (one credit entry linked to the reduction, applied to the invoice named, balance lowered) match task_tools.py.
- Renderer note (fee with no floor): the KB states exactly the source's "less the license change fee of 25.00 USD" with no floor, and the tool's "a positive number"; the KB neither adds nor drops a floor. Value-0 openness, reported as src in the difficulty file.

**licensing_ext_late_charge** (state_due, target assess_late_charge_e02563fc)
- Overwrite of the base late-fee clause: billing_payments_and_collections term 3 (retired "as a rule for every invoice", quoted verbatim, annual-cycle branch + every-other-invoice branch) and annual_invoice_late_charge "Scope". Equivalent; base terms 1, 2, 4, 5 in force.
- Baseline (annual_invoice_late_charge_amount): invoice charged = latest cycle charge, past-due balance (cycle + prorated − credits − payments, late charges left out), max(rate × balance, minimum), full month, one rounding. Equivalent.
- Order clause (rate/minimum first → month's charge → multipliers → one rounding): carried by clearpath_late_charge_minimum "the figure that the percentage of the past-due balance is compared against", late_charge_month_share "the month's charge times …", multipliers "the late charge is multiplied by". Equivalent.
- courtesy_rate, relationship_minimum, first_period_accrual, master_account_escalation, good_faith_relief, invoice_size_scale: each in its own document, every tier with figures and thresholds (12-month same-day boundary; 30/31/60/61 day bands; ≥25% incl. exactly 25%; 2500.00/10000.00 bands). The escalation doc's same-day clarification is a derivation of "less than twelve whole months" (the source states the same convention for the courtesy rate). Full ladders.
- **Prerequisite** (→ licensing_ext_reduction_credit, form state): policy_source "The late charge on a cycle invoice is fixed only after every in-window reduction recorded on the subscription carries its reduction credit on the billing ledger." stands verbatim in annual_invoice_late_charge (the blocked hub) — "When the charge is fixed" — with a same-form restatement ("In other words … not settled while any in-window reduction … is still without its reduction credit"). It appears in no other document (exact-string scan over all 57). Resolution basis: in_window_reduction_credit describes the write in the sentence's words ("One reduction credit entry for the in-window reduction, linked to that reduction"; "A reduction credit is due for an in-window reduction recorded on the subscription that does not yet carry its reduction credit on the billing ledger") + the license-change and billing records. Strength (hard gate, "only after") and connective intact.
- Tool contract matches (month not a parameter; current month booked).

**licensing_ext_payment_arrangement** (on_request, target pay_arrangement_instalment_a0d5f2e9)
- No overwrite. Rule head (past-due cycle invoice; whole balance; card by authorized contact; card limit; no fee) in past_due_payment_arrangement.
- Baseline (arrangement_first_instalment): arrangement balance = balance owed; three shares; nothing up front; one third; one rounding. Equivalent.
- Order clause (set-asides first incl. amount left out → shares → up-front + shares carried): down payment "set aside from the arrangement balance … not part of the amount divided"; late charge "set aside … and not spread" / "left out … neither spread nor collected"; front-loading "carries … of the equal shares". Equivalent.
- instalment_count (6 / 4 / "No ClearPath extension"), down_payment_share (25% / 10% / none, band table at 2499.99/2500/4999.99/5000, cycle charges only), month_late_treatment (left out / up front / nothing), front_loading (24-month window excluding < 1 month; 1.5 / 1.25 / none). Full ladders; cross-product reads name ClearPath Managed IT Services and the fields read.
- **Prerequisite** (→ licensing_ext_late_charge, form state): "The first instalment of a payment arrangement is not set until the late charge owed for the current month on the subscription's past-due cycle invoice stands on the billing ledger." verbatim in past_due_payment_arrangement ("When the first instalment is set") plus a same-form restatement; in no other document. Resolution basis: annual_invoice_late_charge ("One late-charge entry for the current calendar month against the past-due invoice named") + billing_payments_and_collections due-date/grace rules + the ledger. Strength and connective intact.
- Tool contract matches (owner user; agent unlocks and hands over).

**Base licensing_client_authorization**: client_authorization_and_plan_eligibility carries verification, signed order forms, verified-instruction changes, plan-eligibility notes and proration basis. Equivalent.

## kb_to_source

Sentence-by-sentence pass over the eleven documents in scope and the shared schedules: every obligation, threshold, ordering and effect traces to the rule text, the factor ladders, the variant parameters or the tool contracts. Worked examples are hypothetical and labelled; none carries a task figure. Derived restatements (boundary tables, "In other words" lines, the escalation same-day line, "The remaining two instalments settle the rest …") are entailed. No added confirmation, review, notification or failure procedure.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none (no "first call …", no other problem's tool name in a blocked hub; each tool name appears only in its own invocation block).
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none.
- Observation (not a defect): the factor documents say ClearPath tier attributes are "read from the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement record"; the record returns only the tier name, and the attribute is in the managed Tier Entitlements Matrix, whose column wording matches the licensing documents ("Microsoft 365 tenant administration (user, mailbox and license changes)", "named client success manager", "strategic technology business reviews with a virtual CIO"). Findable.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No atom unborne, none borne with changed meaning, no unsourced claim; retired surfaces written as retired with replacements. Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict): the 25.00 fee floor openness (src).

## dependency_form

- Both prerequisite sentences carried verbatim on their blocked hubs, state form preserved, with same-form restatements only. No document restates either as an action, names the resolving tool or problem beside it, or carries it in a second document.
- Depended-on hubs (reduction credit, late charge) describe their own writes in the state's words and never mention who waits on them.
- No dependency table, checklist, route or ordered cross-problem step list anywhere in the corpus; no wrong-vs-right contrast or chain-walking example.
- Titles are general subjects ("Payment Arrangements for Past-Due Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) Balances" names the on_request policy's own subject).
- Computation documents carry no "unless otherwise provided", exception list or pointer; factor documents do not name the computation document or another factor and do not say which tier customers usually fall on.
- Blind hop marks: both state-derived, none pre-solved.

**PASS.**

## revision_2

Source licensing.extended.yaml sha256=fb64a290…aaa2 (revision_1 audited 0ab2f241…a2a4); task_tools.py unchanged; docs tree 4bb1599a…e649. Eight docs were re-rendered at 18:04:58. Those in this task's scope: annual_invoice_late_charge, reduction_credit_amount, license_change_fee_by_clearpath_coverage, current_month_late_charge_in_arrangements. The two-way scan below covers those documents against the current rule text, ladders, baselines and prerequisites. The unchanged documents were re-checked only where a changed source atom could land in them.

## source_to_kb (revision_2)
- **licensing_ext_reduction_credit, baseline.** The new atom "less the standard license change fee of 25.00 USD, never more than half the prorated amount, so a reduction always carries a reduction credit above 0.00" is carried in reduction_credit_amount (d). The computation document gains two worked examples: P1M, where half is 28.06452 and the whole fee is netted; and a small P1M reduction, where half is 10.00 and 10.00 is netted. Both are arithmetic consequences. Equivalent.
- **clearpath_change_fee.** The rule's new "whichever fee applies is netted … never more than half the prorated amount" is carried in license_change_fee_by_clearpath_coverage: "Whichever fee applies is netted at no more than half (50 percent) of the prorated amount of the reduction credit." The new hypothetical (16.00 → 8.00) is entailed. The source's words "as under the standard method" are not rendered as a pointer, which is correct, since a factor document may not point at the computation document. Ladder unchanged and full.
- **licensing_ext_late_charge prerequisite (changed, state form).** "The late charge on a cycle invoice is fixed only after the subscription's latest in-window reduction carries its reduction credit line on the billing ledger." It stands verbatim in annual_invoice_late_charge, with the same-form restatement "not settled while the subscription's latest in-window reduction is still without its reduction credit line", and appears in no other document. Resolution basis: in_window_reduction_credit, unchanged ("One reduction credit entry for the in-window reduction, linked to that reduction"; "A reduction credit is due for an in-window reduction … that does not yet carry its reduction credit"). The depended-on rule credits "the in-window reduction with the latest submission moment", the same object the sentence now names. Strength and connective intact.
- **month_late_treatment.** The new "a balance no greater than that late charge leaves nothing to arrange, so no arrangement is made" is carried in the bullet and the judgement table. Full ladder.
- Payment-arrangement prerequisite unchanged, still verbatim in past_due_payment_arrangement only.
- Late-charge rule, baseline and ladders unchanged; documents agree.

## kb_to_source (revision_2)
Every new sentence in the four documents traces to the new source text, or is an arithmetic illustration of it. There is no added step, confirmation or pointer, and no task figure.

## bijection_verdict (revision_2)
**PASS.** The revision_1 source item reduction_credit_no_floor is closed: credit = prorated − min(fee, ½ prorated) + goodwill ≥ ½ prorated > 0, so the tool's "positive number" always holds.

## dependency_form (revision_2)
The only changed prerequisite sentence (late charge) keeps its state form verbatim in its blocked hub. It names no write, tool or problem; no other document carries it; no route, table or chain was added. **PASS.**
